record.question: List of headings of business to be transacted at a meeting
record.explanation: Answer A: agenda. An agenda is the list of items/business to be transacted at a meeting (A). Independent check: An agenda is the list of matters to be discussed or transacted at a meeting; minutes record what happened. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/agenda; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/agenda. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
